title: NLEADS and ALS interface detail, harness environment, seeding set and evidence gate for RWB-E3-010 are not specified
source: Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 16 and 41 (P2 owns interface config, file runs, outbound items), slide 43 (FileDelivered, FileFailed) and slide 44 (JOB-08 booking confirmation, rwb-payment); Business Requirements Program v4 sections 5.2 and 5.9; legacy RWB-E3-010
section: Template and Rules v1, R7.3 fill order items 1 to 6: no legacy story, module specification, BRD or arch slide gives the interface detail, the harness environment, the seeding set, the evidence format or the pass or fail gate
description: The legacy key names NLEADS and ALS as the systems the agreed plan leaves to, and its endpoint table lists one treatment read. No source in the fill order gives the NLEADS or ALS interface code, transport, message or file layout, test endpoint or result code mapping; nor the harness repository and SIT environment, the seeding set for the treatment, the plan and the booking facts, the evidence report format and its retention, or the pass or fail gate that admits the wave. The harness story therefore carries the interface detail as ASM-B-ITG-W2-08-E3010-2 and the environment, seeding, evidence and gate as ASM-B-ITG-W2-08-E3010-1, and names both in the story rather than inventing any value.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E3-010 in the Epics 3 to 8 story master: acceptance criteria name NLEADS and ALS through the outbound interface and v_ace_account, v_ace_payment and v_ace_plan, and the endpoints table lists only GET /api/recovery/v1/treatments/{treatmentId}. Arch v5 slide 16 gives rwb-integration the interface config, file runs and outbound items but names neither NLEADS nor ALS; slide 43 lists FileDelivered and FileFailed without a layout; slide 44 lists JOB-08 booking confirmation with no file or endpoint. No FSD or TSD module extract, Program BRD requirement or Business Rules row gives an interface code, transport, layout or test endpoint.
area: Integration testing and the NLEADS and ALS outbound interfaces
owner_role: Integration lead with the QA lead
proposed: Fix the NLEADS and ALS interface codes, transports, message or file layouts and test endpoints with the P2 interface owners at the wave 2 entry check; fix the harness repository, the SIT environment, the seeding set, the evidence format and retention and the pass or fail gate with the QA lead. Carry all of them as harness configuration, never as business values in code, and attach the agreed values to this gap before the story is reported Done.
